rows.title: What the evidence base is made of
rows.question: Before any result: what rows exist, how completely are they covered, and how large is each split?

rows.title: Which instruments the analysis covers
rows.question: Is the instrument universe point-in-time, and how did its membership change?

rows.title: Distributions and feature behaviour
rows.question: What do the numeric distributions look like, and which features cannot vary on the rows selected?

rows.title: Microstructure and liquidity proxies
rows.question: What do the liquidity and microstructure proxies show, and which quantities does this data source simply not express?

rows.title: Regime statistics
rows.question: How are regimes distributed over the sample, and how thin is the smallest of them?

rows.title: Dependence and propagation
rows.question: How does movement propagate across instruments, and how strong is the typical association?

rows.title: Tails and extreme risk
rows.question: How heavy are the tails on your slice, and how deep did the drawdowns get?

rows.title: Episode and event statistics
rows.question: How are the injected episodes distributed across instruments and sessions?

rows.title: Leakage verification
rows.question: Can information from after a decision time reach a feature?

rows.title: Validation metrics at a threshold you choose
rows.question: What do the validation metrics say at a threshold you choose?

rows.title: Calibration and uncertainty
rows.question: Are the scores calibrated at the bin count you choose?

rows.title: Error analysis
rows.question: Where does the scoring fail, and what kind of failure is each mistake?

rows.title: Baseline comparison
rows.question: How do the baselines compare, and is the full stack better than something simpler?

rows.title: Ablation study
rows.question: Which components carry the result, and how much does removing each one cost?

rows.title: Robustness and generalisation
rows.question: What survives perturbation, and how much quality is lost when the inputs degrade?

rows.title: Seeds and significance
rows.question: How much of the difference between arms is seed noise?
